settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Console configuration and account settings
settings.connection_mode_desc: Control how RustDesk desktop clients connect: direct P2P (hole punch) when possible, or always via relay.
settings.connection_mode_p2p_first: P2P first (recommended) — try direct connection, fall back to relay
settings.connection_mode_relay_only: Relay only — all sessions use the relay server
settings.connection_mode_same_nat_relay: Force relay when both peers share the same public IP (NAT hairpin)
settings.connection_mode_network_hint: P2P requires UDP port 21116 to be reachable between clients. Signal TCP 21116, relay TCP 21117, NAT test 21115 must be open on the server. Web browser clients always use relay.
settings.connection_mode_not_configurable: Connection mode cannot be changed on this deployment (no systemd unit or docker-compose found)
settings.connection_mode_compose_error: Could not find server environment section in docker-compose.yml
settings.connection_mode_source_defaults: Using server defaults (not writable from panel)
settings.public_endpoints_desc: Hostname and API URL that RustDesk desktop clients use to reach this server. Used for Dashboard client configuration, QR codes, and deploy strings.
settings.public_endpoints_hint: Set these when the web console hostname differs from the RustDesk ID server, relay, or API (reverse proxy / split DNS). Leave empty to auto-detect from the panel URL or Client server address on the Dashboard.
settings.public_endpoints_api_url_hint: Full URL RustDesk clients use for login and API calls (Go server on port 21114 by default).
settings.public_endpoints_invalid_host: Invalid ID or relay server hostname
settings.public_endpoints_invalid_api_url: Invalid API URL — use http:// or https:// with a valid host
settings.public_endpoints_save_confirm: Update RustDesk client configuration values used on the Dashboard (ID server, relay, API URL)?
settings.advanced_desc: Edit server configuration files directly. Changes may require restarting services. A backup copy is created before each save.
settings.advanced_warning: These files contain secrets (API keys, database passwords, session secrets). Only edit if you know what you are doing. Incorrect syntax can prevent the server from starting.
settings.advanced_select_file: Select a file from the list to view or edit its contents.
settings.advanced_restart_after_save: Configuration saved. Restart the affected service now so changes take effect?
settings.advanced_restart_confirm: Restart the related BetterDesk service(s)? Active connections may be interrupted briefly.
settings.advanced_restart_console_confirm: Restart the web console service? Your browser session will disconnect briefly and the page will reload when the console is back.
settings.advanced_restart_polling: Waiting for the console to come back online…
settings.advanced_restart_timeout: Restart was sent but the console did not respond in time. Check systemd/NSSM logs and reload manually.
settings.advanced_restart_failed: Service restart failed (insufficient privileges or service not installed)
settings.advanced_save_confirm: Save changes to this file? A backup of the previous version will be created.
settings.advanced_unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
settings.advanced_no_files: No configuration files available on this system.
settings.advanced_new_file: New file (not created until you save)
settings.advanced_new_file_hint: New file — add content and save
settings.advanced_restart_console: Restart the web console service (e.g. systemctl restart betterdesk-console) for .env changes to take effect.
settings.advanced_restart_goserver: Restart the BetterDesk Go server for blocklist changes to load.
settings.advanced_restart_systemd: After editing systemd units, run: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart <service>
settings.advanced_restart_generic: Restart the affected service for changes to take effect.
settings.advanced_error_not_file: Path is not a regular file
settings.advanced_error_too_large: File exceeds the maximum editable size (512 KB)
settings.advanced_error_binary: Binary files cannot be edited in the panel
settings.advanced_error_not_writable: File is not writable by the console process
settings.advanced_restart_none: No service restart is required for this file.
settings.enrollment_desc: Control how new RustDesk clients register and how operators approve them in the enrollment requests page.
settings.enrollment_require_approval_hint: When enabled, unknown clients are queued until an operator approves them in Enrollment Requests.
settings.enrollment_rich_approve: Full approval form (name, folder, groups, tags)
settings.enrollment_rich_approve_hint: Shows a detailed dialog when approving enrollment or LAN registration requests.
settings.enrollment_tag_picker: Pick tags from existing device tags
settings.enrollment_tag_picker_hint: Lets operators select tags from the list used on the Devices page instead of typing only.
settings.client_sessions_desc: Control how long RustDesk desktop and mobile apps stay signed in to your BetterDesk account.
settings.client_sessions_expiry_hint: Default is 7 days. When sliding renewal is off, clients must sign in again after this period.
settings.client_sessions_sliding_hint: While a client is in use, its session is renewed until the maximum lifetime below.
settings.client_sessions_max_days_hint: Upper limit for sliding renewal from first login (default 30 days).
settings.ldap_desc: Configure external authentication via LDAP or Active Directory. Users will be able to sign in with their domain credentials.
settings.ldap_enabled_hint: When enabled, directory users can sign in with LDAP/AD credentials. Each account stays bound to one auth provider (local, LDAP, or OIDC) — local passwords are not accepted for LDAP-bound users.
settings.ldap_timeout_hint: Seconds to wait for LDAP server response
settings.ldap_direct_bind_hint: Bind directly with a DN template instead of using a service account to search.
settings.ldap_bind_dn_hint: Distinguished Name of a read-only service account used to search for users.
settings.ldap_base_dn_hint: Search base for finding users, e.g. dc=example,dc=com
settings.ldap_user_filter_hint: LDAP filter to find users. Use {{username}} as placeholder. Default: (sAMAccountName={{username}})
settings.ldap_direct_bind_dn_hint: DN template for direct bind. Use {{username}} as placeholder, e.g. uid={{username}},ou=users,dc=example,dc=com
settings.ldap_group_base_dn_hint: Leave empty to use the main Base DN
settings.ldap_default_role_hint: Role assigned to users whose LDAP groups don't match any mapping
settings.ldap_group_role_map_hint: Map LDAP groups to BetterDesk roles. Format: GroupDN=role separated by | (pipe). Example: CN=Admins,DC=example,DC=com=admin|CN=Ops,DC=example,DC=com=operator
settings.ldap_test_success: Connection successful! LDAP server is reachable and bind credentials are valid.
settings.oidc_desc: Configure Single Sign-On via an OpenID Connect provider (Azure AD, Okta, Google, Keycloak, etc.).
settings.oidc_enabled_hint: Allow users to sign in with an external identity provider
settings.oidc_display_name_hint: Text shown on the login button (e.g. Azure AD, Okta)
settings.oidc_issuer_url_hint: OpenID Connect issuer URL (discovery will be automatic)
settings.oidc_redirect_url_hint: Must match your IdP exactly. Path must be /api/auth/oidc/callback (or /api/oidc/callback). Prefer your panel public URL (this page origin) — the console proxies the callback to the Go API. Direct Go/Client API ports (:21114 / :21121) also work.
settings.oidc_panel_url_hint: URL operators use to open the web console (port 5000 or reverse-proxy hostname). Required for SSO login when the OIDC callback runs on the Go API port.
settings.oidc_group_role_map_hint: One mapping per line: group_name=role (e.g. admins=admin, operators=operator)
settings.oidc_issuer_required: Issuer URL is required to test discovery
settings.device_scope_desc: Controls what non-admin users see when no folder, group, or direct device grants exist.
settings.device_scope_open: Open (legacy) — show all devices until ACL is configured
settings.device_scope_restricted: Restricted — show only explicitly granted devices
settings.device_scope_restricted_warning: Restricted mode is active. Ensure users have folder, group, or direct device grants or they will see an empty device list.
settings.backend_desc: Choose which server backend to use for device management and signal/relay services.
settings.backend_rustdesk_desc: Standard RustDesk signal and relay servers (hbbs + hbbr). Basic HTTP API with limited endpoints.
settings.backend_betterdesk_desc: Enhanced Go-based server with full REST API, JWT authentication, blocklist, tags, real-time WebSocket events, and audit logging.
settings.backend_saved: Server backend changed successfully. Device data will now be managed by the new backend.
settings.backend_confirm_switch: Are you sure you want to switch the server backend? This will change how devices are managed.
settings.backend_unreachable: Cannot switch: target server is unreachable. Start the server first.
settings.totp_desc: Add an extra layer of security with TOTP authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
settings.totp_enabled_desc: Your account is protected with two-factor authentication.
settings.totp_disabled_desc: Enable two-factor authentication for additional account security.
settings.totp_step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone
settings.totp_recovery_warning: Save these recovery codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once. If you lose access to your authenticator app, you can use these codes to log in.
settings.totp_disable_warning: Disabling two-factor authentication will make your account less secure. Enter your password to confirm.
settings.go_server_version_dev_hint: Go binary reports development build — rebuild or update the server to match the product version

settings.connection_mode_allow_shared_nat_initiat: Allow shared-NAT initiators (stock clients, multiple devices on one public IP)

Opt-in. When several live peers share one public IP and the client has no login token or udp_port, authorize as shared-nat-initiator. Does not inherit another device identity. Weakens managed enrollment outbound gate for that NAT — enable only for CGNAT/office sites that cannot use account login.

users.username_hint: 3-32 characters, letters, numbers and underscores only
users.password_hint: Minimum 8 characters with mixed case, numbers and symbols
users.role_hint: Server-wide role. Remote Operators connect remotely and can change their own password. Viewers are read-only (no Web Client). Pro License accounts activate RustDesk Pro via the desktop client API only — no web panel access. Organization roles are configured separately.
users.scope_hint: Limit which devices this user sees: assign user groups, folders, and/or direct devices. Without restrictions, operators and viewers see all devices (unless the server uses restricted default mode in Settings).

cross_platform.title: Cross-Platform Compatibility
cross_platform.matrix_hint: Feature support matrix across all supported platforms. Green = full support, yellow = partial, gray = not available, blue = planned.
cross_platform.protocols_hint: Protocol capability negotiation ensures each client receives only the features it supports. The server adapts behavior based on reported capabilities.
cross_platform.no_codec_data: No codec data available from online devices.
cross_platform.no_feature_data: No feature data available from online devices.
cross_platform.limitations_hint: Each platform has specific limitations that affect available features. Review these constraints when planning deployments.
cross_platform.limit_win_uac: UAC elevation required for service installation and input injection on secure desktops.
cross_platform.limit_win_service: Runs as NSSM service under per-service virtual accounts (NT SERVICE\<service>); Administrator required only for installation.
cross_platform.limit_win_firewall: Windows Firewall rules must allow ports 21115-21119 for relay connections.
cross_platform.limit_win_virtual_account: Services run under isolated virtual accounts instead of LocalSystem; custom log paths may need ACL adjustment.
cross_platform.limit_linux_wayland: Wayland compositors restrict programmatic screen capture; PipeWire portal API required.
cross_platform.limit_linux_pipewire: Audio capture requires PipeWire; PulseAudio fallback available but limited.
cross_platform.limit_linux_arm: ARM64 builds available; some codecs may use software decoding (slower).
cross_platform.limit_linux_unprivileged: Services run as dedicated unprivileged 'betterdesk' account with systemd hardening (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict).
cross_platform.limit_mac_screen: Screen Recording permission required in System Preferences > Privacy & Security.
cross_platform.limit_mac_signing: Agent must be signed with Apple Developer ID for distribution.
cross_platform.limit_mac_notarize: Notarization required for macOS Gatekeeper (non-App Store distribution).
cross_platform.limit_android_projection: MediaProjection API requires user consent for each screen capture session.
cross_platform.limit_android_accessibility: Input injection requires AccessibilityService; restricted in Android 14+.
cross_platform.limit_android_battery: Background service limited by Doze mode; may require battery optimization exemption.
cross_platform.limit_ios_capture: Apple prohibits background screen capture; viewer-only mode supported.
cross_platform.limit_ios_input: No input injection permitted; remote viewing and chat only.
cross_platform.limit_ios_appstore: Distribution via App Store only; TestFlight for beta testing.
cross_platform.limit_web_https: WebCodecs API and WebRTC require HTTPS; HTTP falls back to JMuxer (limited codecs).
cross_platform.limit_web_codec: Codec support depends on browser; H.264 widely supported, VP9/AV1 varies.
cross_platform.limit_web_performance: Performance limited by browser sandbox; no direct hardware acceleration.
cross_platform.limit_chrome_crostini: Full agent support only inside Crostini Linux container.
cross_platform.limit_chrome_pwa: PWA mode provides web-only features; no native agent capabilities.
cross_platform.limit_chrome_input: Input injection not supported outside Crostini container.

server_attestation.tier_iron_desc: 26–75 connections — mid-range server (2–4 vCPU, 4–8 GB RAM).
server_attestation.tier_platinum_desc: 76–200 connections — high-performance server (4–8 vCPU, 8–16 GB RAM).
server_attestation.tier_titanium_desc: 201–400 connections — enterprise infrastructure (8+ vCPU, 16–32 GB RAM).
server_attestation.tier_obsidian_desc: 401+ connections — turbo class: dedicated hardware, 16+ vCPU, 32+ GB RAM, NVMe.
